Contract-first transition record for Locking/TX1 follow-up (Items 1A/1B + PR #236 P1/P2/P5). Invariant: no protected row is simultaneously held FOR_UPDATE by transaction T and durably PREPARED for a conflicting writer W, and gateway cleanup clears only process-local bookkeeping without touching durable SQLite reservations. Producers: requestLockingReadReservation & applyLockingReadReservationCommand (src/partition/partition-locking-read-service.js), acquireDbForUpdateReservation/checkDbRowReservation/listDbTableReservationConflicts/releaseDbPartitionTransactionReservations/releaseDbPartitionSessionReservations (src/partition/partition-locking-read-store.js), checkOperationsLockingReadConflict/buildLockConflictAnswerFields/findConflictingPreparedWrite (src/partition/partition-locking-read-write-check.js). Consumers: applyParticipantPrepare/commitPrepared/decideOverPrepared/decideAbsent (src/partition/partition-participant-transaction-apply.js), sealSession/unboundRollback (src/partition/partition-participant-transaction-request.js), PartitionServiceEntryApplyBase.applyCommittedEntry (src/partition/partition-service-entry-apply-base.js), settleLockingReadRefusedCommittedStatement/answerSettledStatement (src/partition/partition-committed-statement-outcome.js), rolledBackCommitFailure/endTransaction (src/query/distributed/distributed-transaction-decision-protocol.js), acquireAuthoritativePartitionReservation/rollbackAcquiredReservations (src/query/sql-locking-read-remote.js), executeLockingReadReservations (src/query/sql-locking-read-execution.js), releasePendingReservations (src/query/sql-query-engine-lifecycle-and-callback-dispatch.js), rollbackOwnedWriteTransaction (src/query/sql-query-engine-write-execution.js). Shape: durable _lagrange_locking_read_reservations keyed by (partition_id, table_name, row_key); DB_LOCKING_READ_ACQUIRE_STATUS (acquired|already_owned|conflict|unavailable) in partition-locking-read-command-constants.js; PARTICIPANT_TRANSACTION_REFUSAL_CAUSE.LOCK_CONFLICT ('lock_conflict') & COMMIT_LOCK_CONFLICT ('commit_lock_conflict') mapped to LOCK_NOT_AVAILABLE / SQLSTATE 55P03; PARTICIPANT_TRANSACTION_SQL.SELECT_PREPARED_ROWS selects transaction_id AS transactionId. Identity/generation: (transactionId, participantId, commitMode, transactionEpoch), canonical rowKey ${tableName}:${partitionId}:${encodeCanonicalPkTupleKey(pkValues)}, deterministic (entryId, commandDigest), partition write generation g / validationText (conflict refusal never advances g). Ordering: reciprocal exclusion in the partition's committed Raft log order (PREPARE-first refuses conflicting ACQUIRE; ACQUIRE-first refuses conflicting PREPARE as REFUSED(lock_conflict) before any global COMMIT decision; commitPrepared and direct-autocommit SQL apply also enforce deterministic SQLite-only checks). Absent vs unavailable: absent row admits; closed/readonly DB on precheck/non-Raft returns typed RESERVATION_UNAVAILABLE; environmental SQLite failure inside Raft apply throws statementEnvironmentFailure to roll back without consuming the entry. Durable commit: single SQLite application transaction commits _lagrange_locking_read_reservations, _participant_transactions, user rows, _partition_statement_outcomes and _raft_rs_applied_state atomically; mirror updates run only in afterCommit. Retained obligations & canonical cleanup: unresolved durable reservations survive write-error cleanup, lost settlement replies, gateway shutdown (releasePendingReservations) and replica restart/leader change until canonical participant settlement or replicated RELEASE_TRANSACTION/RELEASE_SESSION; gateway cleanup clears only local memory (clearTransactionMemoryReservations/clearSessionMemoryReservations) with durable-delete/authority-flag exports (acquireRowReservation, authoritativeDbOnly, releaseTransactionReservations, releaseSessionReservations, releaseSpecificRowReservations) removed and src/query/ -> partition-locking-read-store.js forbidden statically by dependency-cruiser (query-no-durable-locking-read-store).
